articles.summary: ”I like her as a friend, but I’m underwhelmed as a client.”

articles.title: ‘Shark Tank’ star Barbara Corcoran has this one piece of advice for buying a home
articles.summary: Real estate tycoon Barbara Corcoran has revealed the one rule she follows when she is buying homes—explaining how it has helped her ensure she “can always sell” a property later down the line.

articles.title: Novo Nordisk stock climbs out of hole on FDA chief’s threat to block Hims and Hers pill

articles.title: Chase cut my credit-card limit due to lower usage. Will this affect my credit score and lead other banks to do the same?
articles.summary: “I’m wondering whether this could cause a ripple effect in which other banks might do the same with my lesser-used credit cards.”

articles.title: ‘I love being debt-free’: I’m in my mid-50s and buying a house. Do I take out a $400K mortgage or use my Roth IRA?
articles.summary: “I’ll fund $500,000 of that from the sale of my current house.”

articles.title: My brother refuses to sell our family’s $150K lake house, yet I pay all the bills. Do I push it and risk ruining our relationship?
articles.summary: ”I have no intention of going back to the lake house, yet he expects me to pay for upkeep and taxes.”

articles.title: Bitcoin swings wildly after worst day for the pioneering crypto since FTX collapse

articles.title: Bitcoin’s latest selloff is shattering many of its most enduring myths
